movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Beginners hold one or two dhunuchis; experts hold two in their hands.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Communal, aiming to involve the community as a whole.

signature_moves.description: Holding two dhunuchis in the hands and one in the mouth.
signature_moves.name: Three-dhunuchi balance

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the loud, heavy, and rhythmic beat of the dhak drum, accompanied by the metallic resonance of the kansor and ghanta.

basic_steps: Holding one or two dhunuchis while moving to the rhythm of the dhak.
teaching.formation: Communal, involving the community as a whole.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners hold one or two dhunuchis; experts hold three.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythm created by the loud, heavy sounds of the dhak, kansor, and ghanta.
